bluetooth.title: Tesla vehicle discovered
bluetooth.description: A Tesla vehicle ({name}) was discovered. Enter its VIN to continue.

user.title: Add a Tesla vehicle
user.description: Select a discovered vehicle or enter its Bluetooth address manually.

manual.title: Bluetooth address
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth (MAC) address of your Tesla. You can find it in the vehicle's Bluetooth settings screen.

vin.title: Vehicle identification number
vin.description: Enter the 17-character VIN of the vehicle at {address}. The vehicle advertises itself as {expected_name}; currently seen as {advertised_name}.

error.invalid_vin: That does not look like a valid VIN (17 characters, no I/O/Q).
error.invalid_address: That does not look like a valid Bluetooth address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).
error.name_mismatch: The advertised name does not match this VIN. Check both and try again.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a Tesla vehicle.

init.title: Tesla BLE options
init.description: Polling and connection tuning. Lower intervals keep the vehicle awake more often.
